card.category: tunnel (hosted): HTTP/HTTPS tunnel to a localhost web service on a managed free server in Germany
card.summary: Free: TLS/SSL encryption, a time limit on every connection, random URLs, a single EU server; no card required

record.category: tunnel (hosted): HTTP/HTTPS tunnel to a localhost web service on a managed free server in Germany

free_tier.stated: Free: TLS/SSL encryption, a time limit on every connection, random URLs, a single EU server; no card required
free_tier.notes: The pages read name a time limit per connection but publish no duration and no byte figure.

retention.stated: a random subdomain on every connect; the connection is time-limited
retention.notes: no duration is published on the pages read

egress.terms: no byte cap or transfer tolerance is published on the home page or the documentation pages read; the free plan has a per-connection time limit with no stated duration

record.interface_detail: expose share http://localhost:3000; a web dashboard shows and replays the requests
record.tooling: a PHP client (PHAR archive or Composer package, bundled in Laravel Herd) logs in to the managed server with an account token
record.chaining: HTTP and HTTPS only on the pages read, so it fronts a web origin and is not a UDP forward or a WireGuard ingress. The open source PHP server can be run by the user on a rented or free machine as the last option.

limits.value: free plan: a time limit on every connection, a randomized tunnel name for each connection and one server in Germany; no duration and no byte figure is published

record.limits_note: The only published limit is a time limit with no number.
record.binding_note: Nothing countable is published: the free plan states a per-connection time limit without a duration and no byte cap, so no quota can be shown to fail first at 1 TiB per month. The tolerance is unpublished.

identity_cost.detail: a free account with full name, email address and password, or sign-in with GitHub or Google; an hCaptcha challenge is on the form; no card for the Hobby tier

record.reliability_note: The free server is one data center in Germany; a connection is cut by the time limit and then gets a new random URL.
record.confidence_note: Home page, authentication page and registration page read on 2026-11-03; no limit figure is published, so the byte tolerance is unverified.
